label_set.documented-and-verifiable: The detail is stated in an official source AND independently confirmable in a public artifact (repo file, dataset page, doc).
label_set.partially-documented: Some but not all consequential parts of the detail are present; a reconstructor must fill a non-trivial but bounded gap.
label_set.claimed-but-not-verifiable: An official source asserts the detail (e.g., 'we release X') but the referenced artifact is not publicly reachable or does not contain it.
label_set.not-documented: No official source states the detail and it is not present in inspected artifacts; record locations and search terms inspected.
label_set.not-applicable: The criterion does not apply to this benchmark's task type (e.g., judge model for an exact-match metric).
label_set.access-blocked: The artifact exists and is referenced but is gated (login/credential/paywall/region) so its content cannot be verified under our public-only protocol.

outcome_logic.A0-Described: At least one public paper or technical report defines the benchmark (criteria: canonical version, task construction).
outcome_logic.A1-Accessible: Core referenced artifacts (evaluator repo, dataset, sample data) are publicly reachable under stated conditions — no 'claimed-but-not-verifiable' or 'access-blocked' on CORE artifact-linkage criteria.
outcome_logic.R2-Reconstructable: Consequential eval details (metric definition, grading rules, predictions->score mapping, input/output schema, evaluator implementation) are documented-and-verifiable or partially-documented with a bounded gap — NOT claimed-but-not-verifiable or not-documented.
outcome_logic.E3-Smoke-testable: Determined by execution protocol (Phase 5), not by coding alone; requires the evaluator to run on supplied or schema-valid synthetic predictions in the CPU sandbox.
